newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian National Foods sees profits up.
newsitem.headline: Australian National Foods sees profits up.

text.p: Australian National Foods Holdings Ltd (ANF) said on Monday it expected its annual profit for the year to June 30, 1997 to be up about 20 percent on the previous year.
Australian National Foods recorded a net profit of A$833,000 in 1995/96.
The company also said sales in 1996/97 should top A$10 million, compared with A$7.03 million previously.
General manager Gil Hassin said he expected sales and profits in 1997/98 to be boosted by better than expected sales of the company's recently launched soy yoghurt.
"Early estimates indicate the 1997/98 year is likely to deliver a significantly better result than forecast for the current financial year," Hassin said in a statement.
ANF shares were trading unchanged at 92 cents at 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT).
